assumptions.status: Placeholder assumptions; vendor ship-from point and lead time remain open.

openItems.detail: Transit days on Assumptions are placeholders. Need the vendor ship point and production lead time.
Plan treats MSD as the install window opening and CSD (MSD + 7) as the deadline. Confirm with CVS/program manager.

openItems.item: Unit configs for stores not validated
openItems.detail: 30 stores show Not Validated Yet and have no unit config. Plan uses the default and flags them; PO quantities should not be locked until configs are confirmed.
MV vs Store Labor is blank for the not-validated stores and some validated stores (hours 0). Affects who receives/installs.
Amarillo (1543) and New Orleans (10594) are far from any cluster; decide on dedicated delivery or bundling with another run.
Need site delivery hours, dock/no-dock, and receiving contacts per store, particularly for freestanding pads and convenience store types.
Region Summary gives peak-week load; confirm self-perform vs sub and travel/lodging for South TX and outliers.
Once configs firm up, roll units per region into the vendor PO and delivery schedule.
